name: com.thechinacompass/supply-chain-verification
title: The China Compass — China Supplier & Factory Verification
description: Verify Chinese suppliers, CPSC/FDA/FCC/UL lab certs, factory profiles, and FOB/BOM benchmarks.

tools.name: verify_supplier_credential
tools.description: Cross-check a Chinese supplier's test lab ID or compliance code against official accredited registries (US CPSC Lab ID, FDA FEI, FCC Grantee Code, FSC Chain-of-Custody, UL).

query.description: Lab ID, certificate code, or establishment name (e.g. '1024', 'SGS', 'FDA FEI').

tools.name: search_supply_chain_reports
tools.description: Search published China industrial cluster teardown reports including HS codes, origin cluster cities, FOB benchmarks, and trader-vs-factory ratios.

keyword.description: Product keyword, category, HS code, or Chinese industrial cluster city (e.g. 'blender', 'GaN', 'Ningbo').

tools.name: list_verified_factories
tools.description: List desensitized #CN-XX-XXXX verified Chinese manufacturing plants with SAMR registry year, social-security workforce tier, patents, and litigation screening.

tools.name: submit_sourcing_inquiry
tools.description: Submit a B2B supplier verification, desktop due-diligence ($199), or 48-hour on-site factory audit ($690) inquiry to The China Compass.

work_email.description: Buyer business email for audit delivery.

supplier_or_product_input.description: Alibaba/1688 URL, supplier name, #CN-XX-XXXX masked code, or product specification.

destination_country.description: Import destination country (e.g. US, DE, UK, AU).

message.description: Verification scope or target order quantity.
